input.prompt: 7-second, 16:9, 24fps ultra-photorealistic skincare UGC selfie video, continuing exactly from the start image. Keep the woman's exact face, skin texture, freckles, hair, gold hoop earrings, white linen shirt and identity consistent throughout. Keep the exact same small clear glass dropper bottle with the black dropper cap and clear liquid; never change its shape, colour or size, never add a label, never duplicate it. STYLE: authentic end-of-day skincare vlog filmed by herself on a smartphone at arm's length. Relaxed, slightly tired, low-energy, unperformed. Not a polished beauty ad, no presenter gestures, no exaggerated reactions. Warm golden-hour sunlight from frame-left, no ring light. CAMERA: handheld selfie, small tremor, subtle drift, minor framing corrections, occasional autofocus shift, mild wide-angle distortion, natural motion blur, subtle sensor noise. Never gimbal-smooth. 0-3.5s: she lifts the glass dropper fully out of the bottle, squeezes the black bulb and lets two clear drops fall onto the fingertips of her other hand; natural autofocus shift from her face to the drops; she exhales softly. 3.5-7s: she gently presses the serum onto her cheek with her fingertips, lifts them, then slowly turns her face into the warm sunlight; a subtle hydrated sheen catches her cheekbone while pores and freckles stay visible; she looks at the phone screen and gives a tiny delayed half-smile and a small nod. Micro-behaviours: slow blinks, small exhale, loose hair across her cheek, tiny head tilt. Sound: quiet room tone, soft breathing, the faint click of the dropper, no music, no speech. STRICT NEGATIVE: no face drift, no character change, no outfit change, no product change, no extra bottles, no fake label, no plastic or waxy skin, no beauty filter, no glossy ad lighting, no watermark, no subtitles, no text, no UI.
